- When sentiment is high (≥ 0.65) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1–2% for next period.
- After a sharp price spike (e.g., +3%+ in 3–5 days), model often overshoots; cap forecast at +2% above recent peak.
- If sentiment drops below 0.4 in 3+ days, model overreacts to short-term volatility; apply mean reversion bias toward prior 5-day average.
- Model consistently overpredicts 30-day horizon in early October; adjust downward by 0.5–1.5% for dates near 2025-10-15+.
- When sentiment is mixed (0.3–0.6), model exhibits lagged response; delay forecast adjustment by 1–2 days relative to sentiment shift.
- If last 3 sentiment values are 0.0 or negative, model ignores sentiment; force a 0.5–1.0% downward correction to avoid overconfidence.
